scripts.build: npm run build:adult && npm run build:kid
scripts.build:adult: rm -rf ../assets && VITE_APP_MODE=adult vite build && rm -rf ../kid && node scripts/make-redirect.mjs ../app ../
scripts.build:kid: rm -rf ../../ramuse-kid/assets && VITE_APP_MODE=kid vite build && cp public/kid/icon-192.png public/kid/icon-512.png public/kid/apple-touch-icon.png ../../ramuse-kid/ && rm -rf ../../ramuse-kid/kid && node scripts/make-redirect.mjs ../../ramuse-kid/app ../
